reviews.title: A+ Quality and Safe Delivery
reviews.comment:
This is an ideal processor to mate with a Tomahawk board.
The installation is a fresh Windows 11 type, using the autounattend.xml file to avoid installing all the Win11 bloatware, telemetry and nannies.
This CPU has all the hardware requirements for a flawless Win11 installation.
Sadly, the tremendous AI demand has driven the price of RAM memory to 10x over what it was a few years ago.
I would buy this processor, and Intel in general, without hesitation.
reviews.author: Lydia

reviews.title: Didn't Overclock, Just used out of box settings
reviews.comment:
I’m a digital artist, not a gamer, and I needed a processor that could handle high-node complexity in my drawings without lagging. Since my graphics card is a bit on the weaker side, I often offload my processing and video rendering to the CPU, and this Ultra 5 245KF has been a total champion.
I was shocked when I rendered a 30-second video clip using just the processor and it finished in about 3 seconds. It’s efficient, fast, and handles heavy "node-heavy" creative tasks without breaking a sweat.
reviews.author: DW

reviews.title: would have been 5 star, but?
reviews.comment: I bought this cpu because its shows that it is LGA1700 socket, I thought this would be a great match for my Asus TUF Gamming B760-Plus Wifi https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BZT9KYNB?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_fed_asin_title. But as it turns out this is a misprint, it is actually a LGA1851 Socket cpu. So after spending another 250.00 on a new motherboard, this is actually a very advanced processor. Fast and knows what to download to keep all drivers up to date?
